# ResizePhoto.online — exam photo & signature resizers

> Free browser-based photo and signature resizers for exam application forms. Resize, crop and check JPG images against official requirements — GATE 2027 (IIT Madras) and UPSC. All processing happens locally in the browser; images are never uploaded.

## Tools

- GATE 2027 photo & signature resizer: https://resizephoto.online/gate
  - Official source: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/photograph_and_signature
- UPSC photo & signature resizer: https://resizephoto.online/upsc
  - Official source: https://upsc.gov.in
- Exam directory (photo resizers for SSC, IBPS, JEE, NEET, RRB, state exams): https://resizephoto.online/

## GATE 2027 requirements (IIT Madras)

- Photograph: color passport-size, white background, frontal face covering 60-70%, aspect ratio 0.66-0.89, 200x260 to 530x690 pixels, 5-600 kB JPG/JPEG.
- Signature: black or dark-blue ink, JPG/JPEG, aspect ratio 2.75-3.75, signature covering 70-80%, 250x80 to 580x180 pixels, 3-300 kB.

## UPSC requirements

- Photograph: JPG named `photo`, 20-200 kB, face covering at least 3/4 (75%) of the photo, plain white background, both ears visible. No fixed pixel size published.
- Signature: JPG named `signature`, 20-100 kB, 350-500 pixels wide, black pen on white paper.

## How to use

1. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photograph or signature.
2. Crop and position with zoom and rotate controls.
3. Generate a JPG preview, review size checks, then download with the exact file name the portal expects.

## FAQs

- Does the tool upload my image? No. Processing happens in your browser using the Canvas API. No account or server upload.
- Will passing the checks guarantee acceptance? No. Size and dimensions are measurable automatically; face position, glare, shadows and handwriting still need visual review.
- Where do the requirements come from? Official GATE 2027 instructions (IIT Madras) and official UPSC instructions for uploading documents.
